title: Real-Time Monocular Vision-Based UAV Obstacle Detection and Collision Avoidance in GPS-Denied Outdoor Environments Using CNN MobileNet-SSD
authors: Levkovits-Scherer D.S.; Cruz-Vega I.; Martinez-Carranza J.
